verdict.rationale: Swell is API-first commerce: docs show broad backend API coverage (products, stock, purchase links, custom models, schema introspection) and a CLI/functions layer that can automate admin-like workflows (swell-docs-9, swell-docs-22, swell-docs-32, swell-probe-3, swell-probe-rt-1). However there's no explicit claim of full UI/API parity, and probes show no published OpenAPI spec (swell-probe-2) or llms.txt (swell-probe-1), leaving gaps around dashboard-only features like team roles, reporting, and billing settings (swell-docs-17, swell-docs-35) that aren't shown as API-accessible. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation confirming every admin/UI action (roles, reports, billing) is exposed via API, and a complete published API spec.
